source.objective: c2_prepare_codex.py has a TOCTOU race in _roadmap_worktree: after target.exists() returns false, a concurrent preparer can create the same prompt worktree before git worktree add, causing `fatal: .../731707 already exists` instead of re-verifying/adopting the now-existing canonical task/731707 worktree. This occurred while preparing P0 C3 child wi:5eb06a... prompt 731707. Make worktree allocation idempotent under concurrent preparation by re-checking/verifying the target/branch after an add failure caused by concurrent creation.
